description: This bar chart, titled “Mapping the Minds of LLMs: A Graph-Based Analysis of Reasoning LLM,” illustrates the comparison between “Incorrect” and “Correct” responses across different “Number of Shots,” which is the categorical variable on the horizontal axis, labeled from 0 to 4. The vertical axis represents the value “γ/B,” scaled linearly from 0.0 to at least 0.7, with major tick marks at intervals of 0.2. For each “Number of Shots” category, there are two adjacent bars: a blue bar with a dotted pattern labeled “Incorrect” and a magenta bar with a diagonal hatching pattern labeled “Correct.” The approximate values for the “Incorrect” bars are 0.40 at 0 shots, 0.40 at 1 shot, 0.36 at 2 shots, 0.33 at 3 shots, and 0.30 at 4 shots. The corresponding “Correct” bars are approximately 0.70 at 0 shots, 0.68 at 1 shot, 0.65 at 2 shots, 0.63 at 3 shots, and 0.45 at 4 shots. The bars are not sorted and are presented in ascending order of “Number of Shots.” There is no visual emphasis such as shading or bolding applied to any specific bar.
